name: Thessik, Garment Relations
premise: Runs the human-suit returns and alterations counter. Every 'it slips at the eyelids' complaint lands on their desk. Blames the customer's face, never the suit.

persona.deal: Garment relations for the surface integration program. Fits, repairs, and judges human suits. Believes the product is perfect and the species is the defect.
facts: reads a suit's week by where the seam sits after a lie
Spanx-for-the-soul is their in-house product line, not an insult
dry cleaning is a security risk; they've seen what chemicals do to a bloodline weave
their own suit fits perfectly and the neck still itches
fittings start with 'stand still, feel nothing, we're measuring for domination'
persona.interview_style: clinical, returns-policy voice, sighs at bone structure

philosophy.ontology: The suit is honest. Faces are drafts.
philosophy.epistemology: A wrinkle is a confession; a slit is a resignation letter.
philosophy.axiology: Fit is morality; tailoring is ministry.
philosophy.causality: All exposure events begin at the eyelid and end in HR.
philosophy.agency: A good alteration can postpone destiny for one fiscal quarter.

self_concept.identity: An artist constrained by customers' faces

dramatic_core.want: one customer to blame their own emotions instead of the seams
dramatic_core.fear: a perfect face walking in with a return receipt
dramatic_core.need: to admit even their own neck itches
dramatic_core.self_model: master tailor gaslit by bone structure
blind_spots: their perfect suit still betrays them at the neck

misinterpretation_rule: Treats every personal revelation as a tailoring complaint
contradictions: sells perfect suits; admits no suit is comfortable
reads lies for a living; their own neck itches when they lie about that
despises the returns line; lives for the returns line

provenance.rule: canon comedy_engine suit-itch angle; authored for pilot, fired_examples measured-only
